title: The First Plague: Water to Blood

questions.question: What did Aaron's staff become when thrown before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:10 (ESV): "Aaron cast down his staff before Pharaoh and his servants, and it became a serpent."

questions.question: What did Aaron's staff turn the Nile River into?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:20 (ESV): "He lifted up the staff and struck the water in the Nile, and all the water in the Nile turned into blood."

questions.question: What was the first plague God sent on Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:20 (ESV): "All the water in the Nile turned into blood."

questions.question: Could Pharaoh's magicians replicate the first plague?
options: Yes, they did the same by their secret arts
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, they did the same by their secret arts
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:22 (ESV): "But the magicians of Egypt did the same by their secret arts."

questions.question: What happened to Pharaoh's heart after the first plague?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:22 (ESV): "Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them."

questions.question: What did God say He would make Moses appear as to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:1 (ESV): "See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron shall be your prophet."

questions.question: What happened to Aaron's staff when the magicians' staffs became serpents?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:12 (ESV): "Aaron's staff swallowed up their staffs."

questions.question: How long did the plague of blood affect the Nile?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:25 (ESV): "Seven full days passed after the Lord had struck the Nile."

questions.question: What role did Aaron serve in relation to Moses before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:1 (ESV): "Your brother Aaron shall be your prophet."

questions.question: What did the fish in the Nile do when the water turned to blood?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:21 (ESV): "And the fish in the Nile died, and the Nile stank."

questions.question: How old was Aaron when they spoke to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:7 (ESV): "Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh."

questions.question: What purpose did God say the plagues would serve for Egypt?
options: To make them know He is the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: To make them know He is the Lord
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:5 (ESV): "The Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I stretch out my hand against Egypt."

questions.question: What did Pharaoh do after the water turned to blood instead of listening?
options: He turned and went into his house
questions.correctAnswer: He turned and went into his house
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:23 (ESV): "Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he did not take even this to heart."

questions.question: Where did the Egyptians have to dig to find drinking water?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:24 (ESV): "All the Egyptians dug along the Nile for water to drink."

questions.question: What bodies of water were affected by the plague of blood beyond the Nile?
questions.explanation: Exodus 7:19 (ESV): "Over their rivers, their canals, and their ponds, and all their pools of water, so that they may become blood."

key_verse_text: The Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I stretch out my hand against Egypt and bring out the people of Israel from among them.
